title: International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy Nutrition
excerpt: Oats, Greek yogurt, lentils, low-mercury salmon, eggs, leafy greens, and citrus — practical ways to build balanced plates
content:
## Introduction to Pregnancy Nutrition
Pregnancy nutrition plays a crucial role in ensuring the health and well-being of both mother and baby. Throughout pregnancy, the mother's body requires adequate nutrition to support the growth and development of the fetus. A balanced and varied diet is key to ensuring the health of both mother and baby.

## International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy
There are many international pantry staples that are beneficial for pregnant women, including:
- Oats: rich in fiber, which helps support digestive health and reduce the risk of constipation.
- Greek yogurt: rich in calcium, which helps support the development of the fetus's bones and teeth.
- Lentils: rich in fiber, protein, and iron, which helps support the growth and development of the fetus and reduce the risk of anemia.
- Low-mercury salmon: rich in omega-3 fatty acids, which helps support the development of the fetus's brain and eyes.
- Eggs: rich in protein, vitamins, and minerals, which helps support the growth and development of the fetus.
- Leafy greens and citrus: rich in vitamins and minerals, which helps support immune function and reduce the risk of illness.

## Building Balanced Plates for Pregnancy
To build a balanced and varied diet, pregnant women can combine international pantry staples with traditional Vietnamese foods. Here are some suggestions:
- A bowl of oatmeal with Greek yogurt and fresh fruit, with a side of steamed vegetables and a glass of orange juice.
- A lentil salad with leafy greens and citrus, topped with a grilled chicken breast or a piece of low-mercury salmon.
- A plate of grilled low-mercury salmon with roasted vegetables and quinoa.
- A breakfast plate of scrambled eggs with whole-grain toast and a side of sautéed spinach.
- A bowl of lentil soup with a side of whole-grain bread and a glass of freshly squeezed orange juice.

## Food Safety Considerations
When preparing and consuming food during pregnancy, it is essential to consider food safety to reduce the risk of illness. Here are some tips:
- Wash hands before preparing and consuming food.
- Wash fresh fruits and vegetables before consuming.
- Cook food thoroughly before consuming.
- Avoid consuming expired or spoiled food.

## Conclusion
Pregnancy nutrition is a critical aspect of prenatal care. Pregnant women can combine international pantry staples with traditional Vietnamese foods to build a balanced and varied diet. To learn more about pregnancy nutrition and find delicious and nutritious recipes, visit our [meal planner](/planner) or [read more about related topics](/blog/topics).

## When to Seek Help
If you have any questions or concerns about pregnancy nutrition, consult with your healthcare provider or a registered dietitian for personalized guidance and support.
